issues.description: The rendered typography is consistently larger, wider, and heavier than the source. The mismatch is most pronounced in the subtitle and node labels, which occupy substantially more horizontal space and make the flow feel denser even though all wording and node geometry are correct.

changes.font_metrics: use source-matched Microsoft YaHei metrics and verify rendered line widths
changes.font_size: reduce title, subtitle, node, annotation, and feedback text to the source-matched apparent sizes
changes.font_weight: reduce the apparent weight of node and feedback labels to match the source

background_seams.rationale: The flat background and two clipped decorative circles remain continuous, with no hard rectangular seams or texture discontinuities.

connector_endpoints.rationale: Blue branch and forward arrowheads point to their intended nodes, merge segments meet cleanly, and the orange feedback arrowhead clearly terminates at the input node without repeated floating endpoints.

connector_topology.rationale: The input splits to design and risk review, both branches merge before execution, execution flows to acceptance, and the orange feedback path closes the loop back to input exactly as in the source.

crop_boundaries.rationale: Neither the source nor the render uses raster image assets or cropped artwork; the diagram is composed of text, shapes, and connectors.

key_proportions.rationale: Node sizes, branch spacing, merge position, feedback-loop footprint, page margins, and overall visual balance match the source closely.

typography_hierarchy.rationale: All text levels remain logically ordered and aligned, but the render's consistently oversized and heavier text materially departs from the source and increases visual density.

visual_depth.rationale: The source's flat pastel fills, rounded borders, connector layering, and restrained depth treatment are faithfully retained.
